name: Moondragon

abilityDetails.Energy Vulnerability: Enerji Direncini azaltarak saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen enerji hasarını artırır.
abilityDetails.Incinerate: Zamanla enerji tabanlı yakma hasarı verir ve zırhı yok sayar.
abilityDetails.Pre-Fight: Dövüş başlamadan önce Pre-Fight ekranından değiştirilebilen yetenek.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Bloktan vurulunca enerji hasarı verir, E1'de 3sn görünmez olur, purify erişimi var. Onu duvara sıkıştırıp E1'e zorlamak işe yarar; enerji dirençli şampiyonlar avantajlı.
signatureAbility:
Disciple of The Shao-lorn
Heavy Attacks gain [687.5 - 4,124.92] Critical Rating while under 1 Bar of Power.
Heavy Attacks inflict an indefinite Energy Vulnerability Debuff. If punishing a Special Attack, trigger a Mind Blast instead.
Special Attacks are Passively Unblockable.
immunityDetails:
• Kontrolleri Tersine Çevirme Bağışıklığı 🧠
• %30-%80 Kanama direnci 🩸
• %30-%80 Zehir direnci 🧪

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: Moondragon's telepathic power grants her Immunity to Reversed Controls.
Reduce the potency of incoming Bleed, Power Sting, Degeneration, and Poison effects from Champions or Quest Buffs by 30%.

abilitySections.title: Mind Blasts
content: Mind Blasts are triggered when Interrupting Heavy Attacks or hitting the Opponent's Block with Moondragon's first Medium or Light Attack. Mind Blasts do not trigger on Well-Timed Blocks.
Starting a Combo by Intercepting Dash Attacks or Interrupting Medium and Light Attacks triggers Mind Blasts for the entire 5-hit Combo.
Mind Blasts deal a burst of [1,916.4] Energy Damage and grant 1% of Max Power.

abilitySections.title: Psionic Charges
content: Gain 1 Psionic Charge when triggering a Mind Blast.
While suffering from Bleed, Power Sting, Degeneration, or Poison effects from Champions and Quest Buffs, gain a Psionic Charge every 0.75 seconds.
Psionic Charges grant +[102.7] Critical Damage Rating.

abilitySections.title: Psionic Transcendence
content: Upon reaching 20 Psionic Charges, Moondragon Purifies all Debuffs and enters Psionic Transcendence for 15 seconds.
Gain 1 Psionic Charge for each Debuff Purified.
Upon entering Psionic Transcendence, inflict 5 indefinite Energy Vulnerability Debuffs reducing Energy Resistance by [485.29]. Max Stacks: 25
Inflict an additional Energy Vulnerability Debuff when gaining new Psionic Charges.
Reduce the potency of incoming Bleed, Power Sting, Degeneration, and Poison effects from Champions by an additional flat 50%.
Moondragon's hits cannot be Evaded.
Psionic Transcendence is paused during the Opponent's Special Attacks and for 2 seconds when a Psionic Charge is gained.
All stacks of Energy Vulnerability and Psionic Charges are removed when Psionic Transcendence ends.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: After the final hit, gain 3 Psionic Charges and begin channeling to gain up to 6 more. Moondragon stops channeling if she performs an action or is struck.
After the final hit, incoming Basic Attacks Passively Miss for 3.1 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: All hits deal a burst of [3,832.8] Energy Damage, multiplied by Moondragon's Critical Damage Multiplier.
Psionic Transcendence is paused during this attack.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Inflict an Incinerate Debuff, dealing [22,038.6] Energy damage over 25 seconds. Incinerate also removes Perfect Block Chance and decreases Block Proficiency by 50% while active.
If Psionic Transcendence is active, this attack inflicts a Critical Incinerate Passive, multiplying its Energy Damage by Moondragon's Critical Damage Multiplier.
Psionic Transcendence is paused while this Incinerate is active.

abilitySections.title: Presence of the Moondragon - Pre-Fight Ability
content: Moondragon starts each quest with 1 Persistent Charge, which can be spent in the Pre-Fight screen on the Presence of the Moondragon ability.
Gain 1 Persistent Charge back each time an Opponent is knocked out by Moondragon. Max Stacks: 3
Presence of the Moondragon: At the start of the next fight, gain 3 Passive Dragon of the Moon charges granting immunity to Reversed Controls. Remove 1 charge when this immunity is triggered.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Disciple of The Shao-lorn
content: Heavy Attacks gain [687.5 - 4,124.92] Critical Rating while under 1 Bar of Power.
Heavy Attacks inflict an indefinite Energy Vulnerability Debuff. If punishing a Special Attack, trigger a Mind Blast instead.
Special Attacks are Passively Unblockable.
